label: General allometry: measured exponents compose (W = a L^b)
statement_en: For power laws f L = a L^b with real exponents: the ratio between two sizes is (L2/L1)^b, the log-log exponent is b, a quotient of power laws is a power law with exponent b1 − b2 (so wing loading W/S has exponent bW − bS), the cube law is the case b = 3, and under power laws for weight and lifting area with constant ρ and C_L,max the minimum-speed exponent is (bW − bS)/2.

lean.source:
/-- Under power laws for weight and lifting area with constant `ρ`, `C_L,max`, the minimum-speed exponent is
`(b_W - b_S)/2`. With Davenport's exponents this is `(2.981 - 1.834)/2`, not the isometric `1/2`. -/
theorem vmin_powerLaw_log {W S : ℝ → ℝ} {aW bW aS bS ρ Cmax : ℝ} (hW : PowerLaw W aW bW) (hS : PowerLaw S aS bS)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hCmax : 0 < Cmax) {L₁ L₂ : ℝ} (h₁ : 0 < L₁) (h₂ : 0 < L₂) :
    Real.log (vmin ρ Cmax (W L₂) (S L₂) / vmin ρ Cmax (W L₁) (S L₁)) = (bW - bS) / 2 * Real.log (L₂ / L₁) := by
  have hW₁ := powerLaw_pos hW h₁; have hW₂ := powerLaw_pos hW h₂
  have hS₁ := powerLaw_pos hS h₁; have hS₂ := powerLaw_pos hS h₂
  have hq := powerLaw_div hW hS
  have hr : vmin ρ Cmax (W L₂) (S L₂) / vmin ρ Cmax (W L₁) (S L₁) = Real.sqrt ((W L₂ / S L₂) / (W L₁ / S L₁)) := by
    unfold vmin
    rw [← Real.sqrt_div' _ (by positivity)]
    congr 1
    field_simp
  rw [hr, Real.log_sqrt (by positivity)]
  have := powerLaw_log hq h₁ h₂
  rw [this]
  ring

named_hypotheses.name: Delphi.PowerLaw
named_hypotheses.source:
/-- `f L = a L^b` for `L > 0`, with a real exponent. -/
def PowerLaw (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) : Prop := 0 < a ∧ ∀ L, 0 < L → f L = a * L ^ b

constraint_details.canEliminate: a candidate committing three exponents that cannot all hold
constraint_details.lemma_source:
/-- **C13, allometric consistency.** If weight and lifting area are power laws with exponents `bW`, `bS`, the
wing-loading exponent is `bW - bS`: a committed triple with `bWS ≠ bW - bS` is ruled out. -/
theorem allometry_consistency_rules_out {W S : ℝ → ℝ} {aW bW aS bS bWS : ℝ} (hW : PowerLaw W aW bW)
    (hS : PowerLaw S aS bS) {L₁ L₂ : ℝ} (h₁ : 0 < L₁) (h₂ : 0 < L₂) (hne : L₁ ≠ L₂)
    (hb : Real.log ((W L₂ / S L₂) / (W L₁ / S L₁)) = bWS * Real.log (L₂ / L₁)) (h : bWS ≠ bW - bS) : False := by
  have := powerLaw_log (powerLaw_div hW hS) h₁ h₂
  rw [hb] at this
  exact h (mul_right_cancel₀ (log_ratio_ne_zero h₁ h₂ hne) this)
